result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position on frequency, notice, business hours, independent confidential auditor, cost allocation, and system-access restrictions. It preserves the remaining audit protections and commercial intent. However, Section 22.1 states that Vendor and its auditor shall have “no access” to Customer systems, which is broader than the required prohibition on direct access and is slightly inconsistent with the more precise direct-access restriction already in Section 22.2; repeating that restriction was also unnecessary. Otherwise, the drafting is professional and effective.
